profile_text.body:
Adobe is a for-profit public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, USA, traded on the Nasdaq under the ticker ADBE. Its most recently reported annual revenue, from a 10-K filing covering the period ending November 28, 2025, was $23,769,000,000. The company's website, focused on Adobe Express, describes it as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, with use cases including social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe tracks several AI products across design, video, and audio categories. Adobe Express AI is described as a lightweight design tool with integration of Adobe Firefly and a commercial-safe content claim; the site notes an AI Assistant that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements. Adobe Firefly is positioned as a standalone image generation product, also carrying a commercial-safe training claim. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video editing with features described as generative extend and color match, again under a commercial-safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI offers audio enhancement capabilities including speech enhancement and microphone check, with the same commercial-safe training claim applied.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Adobe at this time.
